<details><summary>What the change connects to (6 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**

- Drag handle on a ready copy starts a native file drag (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:171`) — The OS drag carries the vault file under the copy's title. If it fails: startFileDrag returns void, so a failure in main gives the renderer nothing to show. This matches the siblings. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:231-235`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/gif-viewer.tsx:25-27`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/electron-api.ts:255-259`.
- The page now probes every local recording to get its resolution, the destination estimates and each copy's picture size (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:142`) — The resolution appears in the meta line, sizes appear on the cards, and dimensions appear on copy rows. If it fails: When the probe fails, status is 'error' but the page drops it, so the cards show '…' indefinitely and the meta line and copy dimensions are simply missing. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:42-67`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destinations-panel.tsx:41-56`.
- A destination card or Not now in DestinationsPanel (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:489`) — Prepare opens on the chosen destination. After Not now, the panel is hidden and 'Export a copy' appears. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:149-151`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:139`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:190-191`.
- A destination card in "Where is it going?" opens Prepare on that destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destinations-panel.tsx:82`) — The router goes to /prepare/:assetId?to=<id>. The tests assert all six search strings. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destinations-panel.tsx:73-93`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:149-151`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:384-387`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.test.tsx:253-266`.
- "Not now" hides the destinations panel and brings back Export a copy (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:494`) — The panel disappears, and the primary Export a copy button appears in the actions (:436), opening Prepare with no ?to=. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:138-139`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:190-191`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:436-441`, `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/prepare-screen.md:101-102`.
- The "Saved to your Library" notice shows on a fresh recording until ✕ (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:394`) — The notice shows over the player and the masterNote is hidden until ✕. If it fails: On router Back from Prepare the component remounts under the same history entry with fromRecording still set, so a dismissed notice comes back. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:101`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:128-137`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:341`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:407`.

</details>

<details><summary>What the reviewer checked</summary>

**Batch 1 of 2.** I found no defects in this part: three "consider" findings, no blockers or fixes.

- **Probe failure:** the page now reads the file for every local recording, but it ignores the probe's error status. An unreadable file leaves the destination cards on "…" indefinitely, which looks the same as loading.
- **Tests:** the "Open in Export" test never checks that the button is absent without a callback, and the drag test overwrites `window.electronAPI.startFileDrag` without restoring it.

I checked these against the code and they hold:

- The Drag handle matches the existing native-drag call sites.
- Copy picture sizes come from fixed preset sizes, so leaving out framing has no effect.
- The destination cards and Not now go through the same `openPrepare` path the old strip used.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I found nothing that needs fixing in this part; there is one minor finding to consider.

- **What checks out:** The tests, stylesheets, backlog docs and en/es messages match the new recording page in `library-detail-page.tsx` and `destinations-panel.tsx`:
  - the title row;
  - "Where is it going?" with one card per destination, and "Not now";
  - "Copies from this original";
  - the "Saved to your Library" notice;
  - the file is now read for every local recording, so the old "probe not called" assertion is correctly dropped.
- **Messages:** The removed keys have no remaining users. `sendTo` is kept because the Library's card and row still use it.
- **Finding (consider, tests):** If the user dismisses the new "Saved" notice, then goes to Prepare and presses Back, the notice comes back. The dismissal lives in component state, while `fromRecording` stays on the history entry. No test covers that round trip.

I report no risk facts and no judgement items.

</details>
